messages.subject: arranging facets
parts:
Hi ggplot2 experts

Sorry for too basic question, I do not know...

I have to make histogram of 24 variables, so I melted the data into
two variables : variable and value.

I want to plot a multiple facet histogram:

qplot(value, data = mel.data, geom = c("histogram"), fill =
factor(variable)) + facet_grid( ~ variable) +
opts(panel.margin=unit(0 , "lines"))

This will arrange the histogram in 1 x 24 arrangement, not good for
presentation.

I want them to be arranged in 6 x 4 fashion. I know lattice can do it
easily, it will fit in to the area provided. I did not find way to do
in ggplot2.

Thanks
Ram

Use facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol=4).
